novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new mechanism/measurement route—“an internal, decodable confidence estimate” whose “trajectory predicts when additional reasoning stops changing the answer”—rather than merely using output entropy. The closest prior work is Re-FORC (2025), which predicts future rewards to enable adaptive chain-of-thought stopping, alongside REFRAIN (2025) and LEASH (2025) for adaptive stopping, and PHi (ICML 2025) for hidden-state signals correlated with reasoning correctness; searches using “internal activation confidence adaptive stopping reasoning,” “hidden state confidence early exit chain of thought,” and “activation probe answer stabilization reasoning” did not identify an essentially equivalent activation-trajectory stopping rule. The step from these works to the claim is a substantive but fairly natural extension—replacing reward, linguistic redundancy, or output-logit signals with a probe over intermediate activations and linking it to answer stability—so the idea is more than a direct object transfer but does not introduce a fundamentally new measurement paradigm.
